feeds.description: List of feed sources (XML URLs) providing 0install packages. At least one feed is recommended for package resolution.

feeds.items.url.description: URL to the feed's XML manifest (e.g., 'https://example.com/app.xml')

feeds.items.name.description: Optional human-readable name for the feed (for logging/annotation).

default_selection.description: Default selection criteria to use when resolving implementations (applies globally unless overridden per-feed).

trust.description: List of trusted GPG fingerprints or hashes to skip manual trust prompts.

trust.items.fingerprint.description: GPG key fingerprint (e.g., 'A1B2C3D4E5F6...') or SHA256 hash.

trust.items.name.description: Optional human-readable name for the key owner.

mirrors.description: Optional list of mirror URLs for feed sources to improve availability or reduce bandwidth.

mirrors.items.feed_url.description: The primary feed URL these mirrors serve.

mirrors.items.urls.description: List of mirror URLs for the feed (e.g., CDN mirrors or regional mirrors).

network_policy.description: Network behavior: 'online' (default), 'cached' (only use cached data), 'offline' (no network).

arch.description: Preferred architecture override (e.g., 'amd64', 'arm64'). If omitted, auto-detected.
